name: Lessons in Lust
source:
You’ve got the career, the friends, and the apartment. What you don’t have is a decent night’s sleep, thanks to your neighbor’s very active love life and one criminally thin wall. When you finally knock, you’re ready to demand some peace and quiet. You’re considerably less prepared for Dash.

The infuriatingly attractive tattoo artist next door has an offer: private lessons in the confidence and chemistry your own love life could use. One month. Clear boundaries. No sleepovers. It sounds manageable - until the person teaching you how to turn up the heat becomes the only person you want to practice with.
